top_signals.title: Britain’s next war won’t be an away game: Q&A with former head of Defence Intelligence
top_signals.summary: As Chief of Defence Intelligence, General Sir Jim Hockenhull decided to declassify and publish what London knew of Russia’s plans to invade Ukraine, down to a map of the routes its forces would take.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stocks Erase Gains Amid Profit Taking, Rate Hike Fears Mount
top_signals.summary: US stocks erased the morning’s gains early Wednesday afternoon following Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari’s comment that it’s time for the central bank to start slowly raising rates and as strategists see profit taking in the recent tech rally.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Barclays, HSBC Say Inflation-Protected Bonds Appeal
top_signals.summary: Barclays Plc and HSBC Holdings Plc say concern the Federal Reserve is dragging its feet on inflation is giving investors another reason to buy bonds that offer protection from accelerating price growth.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.summary: Copper futures on New York’s Comex climbed to a record high as investors awaited a decision on US tariffs, while also tracking a push to reopen the Strait of Hormuz that lifted demand for risk assets.

alerts.title: US’ First National Coast Guard Museum Set to Open in One Year
alerts.summary: One year from today, Americans will have the opportunity to experience the National Coast Guard Museum, the first national museum dedicated to preserving and sharing the history, heritage, and missions of the Coast Guard. The museum will open to the public during the week of Aug.
